alex: FYI FinServ customer asked for a crisp POC scoping doc tonight. Need success criteria, prompt evals, token estimates, GPU recs, and a POC budget.
jordan: I can lead the doc. Can ppl drop short numbers here and I'll stitch.
maria: security wants retention and KMS answers up front. Their compliance team is tight.
sanjay: quick read: use-case is live chat answers + doc search (5k docs) + nightly batch ingest.
kevin: baseline traffic they gave: 60 concurrent testers during demo windows, ~2 requests/user/hour for slow investigative flows.
alex: that translates to ~120 req/hr steady, but we should plan for 4x spikes during demo runs -> 480 req/hr peak.
sanjay: tokens: average prompt 120, response 330 -> 450 tokens/roundtrip. so peak tokens/hr = 480 * 450 = 216,000 tokens/hr. for a 4-hour demo window = ~864k tokens/demo-day.
jordan: good. present low / expected / peak scenarios in the one-pager. low = 25% of these numbers, expected = 1x, peak = 3x.
kevin: GPU recs: for a quantized 8-bit 33B model we can run ~60 concurrent streams on 1x A100-40GB for interactive latency ~450ms; for p95 < 350ms recommend 1x H100 or 2x A100s with optimized kernels. If they want redundancy + autoscale, reserve 2 GPUs (primary + warm).
maria: include security checklist: keys in customer KMS, logs retained 14 days by default, option for ephemeral storage in private deploy, PII redaction hooks, SOC2 controls enabled. call out legal review for PCI/HIPAA.
alex: success criteria (proposed short): 1) p95 latency < 350ms for conversational flows; 2) accuracy >= 88% on 20 eval prompts set; 3) zero unredacted PII in 100 manual tests; 4) ingest pipeline completes within 25 minutes for 5k docs.
kevin: cost sketch (hosted): token price assumption $0.00025/token model+compute. For expected daily demo workload (864k tokens) -> $216/day. For 2-week POC with 4 demo days/week -> ~ $2.5k token spend. Add GPU reserved baseline: $3.5k/week for A100 baseline, standby adds ~$2k/week. So total 2-week budget ~ $10k30k depending on intensity and standby.
sanjay: also propose a cost-saving fallback: use a smaller 13B quantized model for non-critical flows; caching repeated Qs reduces token spend ~25%.
jordan: pls add a compact table: scenario | tokens/day | est token cost/day | infra note. Keep doc to one page.
kevin: uploading POC template now -> https://drive.redwood/poc-templates/finserv-poc-template-v2.docx
build-bot: reminder: POC checklist created by kevin at 2025-02-10T09:14:55Z :wrench:
maria: action items: (1) alex -> one-pager draft + table (by 18:00), (2) kevin -> attach pricing worksheet (by 17:30), (3) sanjay -> short capacity calc + GPU bullets (by 17:00), (4) maria -> security appendix + legal flags (ASAP).
alex: will do. I'll include 25 gold eval prompts across transaction, failure, ambiguous intents, and PII tests.
jordan: we'll review tomorrow 09:00 PT before sending. thanks all.
kevin: done uploading.
alex: drafted and shared link in thread: https://drive.redwood/poc-drafts/finserv-onepager-alex-v1
jordan: nice. :thumbsup:
